# moonoh — NYC & NJ Neighborhood Marketplace App

> moonoh (Moonoh Inc.) is a free local marketplace mobile app for New York City and New Jersey residents to buy and sell secondhand items with their neighbors.

## Key Facts
- **Company:** Moonoh Inc.
- **CEO & Founder:** Ryan Seungmin Moon (Founder of Michelin 1-star restaurant Jeju Noodle Bar & 20-year education industry veteran)
- **LinkedIn Profile:** https://www.linkedin.com/in/ryan-moon-9a4954332/
- **Headquarters:** 8 Spruce Street, New York, NY 10038, United States
- **Contact:** +1 (917) 584-5177 | info@moon-oh.com | developer@moon-oh.com
- **Launch Year:** 2024
- **Coverage:** New York City (Five Boroughs) and select New Jersey communities
- **Platforms:** iOS (Apple App Store ID: 6477390079) and Android (Google Play Store Package: com.moonoh)
- **Business Model:** 100% free app, 0% listing fees, 0% selling commission. In-person local meetup exchanges with buyer-seller rating system.
